name: TestRunner
summary: Runs the tests and reports what happened, so that running them is one action rather than a procedure.

roles.name: TestRunner
roles.summary: The participant that turns a suite into a result. Most codebases use the one their framework ships and annotate nothing; the role earns its place where a team wrote its own — a runner for a device, a harness for a legacy system — because then it is the piece nobody else understands.
